data.name: Summon Mantis
data.description: Once per day, you may summon an advanced fiendish giant mantis, 1d3 fiendish giant mantises, or 1d4+1 giant mantises, as if using Summon Monster V. You can mentally direct these blood-red summoned vermin as a free action.
